concept.name: Objective function
concept.definition: A scalar criterion that fitting or optimization seeks to minimize or maximize, optionally combining data loss and penalties.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Compute the criterion from predictions, targets, parameters, and constraints; use its gradient or search comparisons to update the candidate solution.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A model minimizes validation log loss plus 0.01 times the sum of squared weights.
